cases.sentence: Народ Израиля тронулся в путь из ___.
cases.translation: The people of Israel set out on the journey from Elim.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Там мы сидели у ___ с мясом и ели хлеб досыта.
cases.translation: There we sat by the pots of meat and ate bread to the full.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Вы вывели нас в пустыню, чтобы весь народ уморить ___.
cases.translation: You brought us out into the wilderness to kill the whole people with hunger.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means (to kill by hunger).

cases.translation: The glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Tell the congregation of Israel: come before the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to tell someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.
The preposition пред (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Берите по ___ на каждого члена семьи.
cases.translation: Take an omer for each member of the family.
cases.explain: The distributive preposition по governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The Lord has given you the Sabbath.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb дать takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: В тот же вечер налетели перепела и накрыли лагерь, а утром вокруг лагеря легла роса.
reading.question: What happened in the evening and in the morning?
options: Quail covered the camp in the evening, and dew lay around it in the morning
Manna fell twice in one day
reading.correct: Quail covered the camp in the evening, and dew lay around it in the morning
reading.explain: The text says quail 'накрыли лагерь' in the evening and dew 'легла' around the camp in the morning.

reading.ru: Израилетяне ели манну сорок лет, пока не пришли в заселенную землю.
reading.question: How long did the Israelites eat manna?
reading.explain: The text says 'Израилетяне ели манну сорок лет' (the Israelites ate manna for forty years).

reading.ru: Народ Израиля назвал эту пищу манной, она была белой, как кориандровое семя, а на вкус, как медовое печенье.
reading.question: What was the manna like?
options: White like coriander seed, tasting like wafers with honey
Dark like bread and bitter to taste
reading.correct: White like coriander seed, tasting like wafers with honey
reading.explain: The text says it was 'белой, как кориандровое семя' and tasted 'как медовое печенье' (white like coriander seed, like honey wafers).

reading.ru: Некоторые из народа вышли собирать в седьмой день, но ничего не нашли.
reading.question: What happened when some went out to gather on the seventh day?
reading.explain: The text says those who went out on the seventh day 'ничего не нашли' (found nothing).

reading.ru: В пище завелись черви, и она стала зловонной.
reading.question: What happened to the food that some kept until morning against the command?
options: It bred worms and became foul
reading.correct: It bred worms and became foul
reading.explain: The text says 'В пище завелись черви, и она стала зловонной' (worms bred in the food and it became foul).

reading.ru: Они ели манну, пока не достигли рубежей Ханаана.
reading.question: Until when did they eat the manna?
options: Until they reached the borders of Canaan
reading.correct: Until they reached the borders of Canaan
reading.explain: The text says they ate manna 'пока не достигли рубежей Ханаана' (until they reached the borders of Canaan).
